reviewer: Codex author source review; independent approval pending

owner_creation.analysis: OWN-11: The cycle owns interrupt atomics and sigs while libc retains handler registrations; stack sigaction/pollfd/mask values live only through their calls.
owner_creation.invariant: Kernel callback registrations borrow stable code addresses.
limitations: This is source review of current registrations, wakeup and callback lifetime; it does not close job-control, callback-provider or independent review gates.

aliases_escapes.analysis: OWN-11: Handlers access global screen/filter/queue state that the interrupted main path may already be using; u_interrupt frees filters and sigusr1 enters queue construction.
aliases_escapes.invariant: Interrupted owner aliases are not yet protected by dispatch.
limitations: This is source review of current registrations, wakeup and callback lifetime; it does not close job-control, callback-provider or independent review gates.

callback_targets.analysis: OWN-11: Targets are u_interrupt, stop, lwinch, terminate, sigalarm and sigusr1; default/ignored/error sentinels still pass through Option function-pointer transmutes.
callback_targets.invariant: Real code targets and signal sentinel values remain distinct concepts.
limitations: This is source review of current registrations, wakeup and callback lifetime; it does not close job-control, callback-provider or independent review gates.

invalidation.analysis: OWN-11: init_signals replaces dispositions for handoff and restores them later; concurrent handler mutations can invalidate filters or cleanup state before main-loop resumption.
invalidation.invariant: Handoff must retire callbacks before changing their owners.
limitations: This is source review of current registrations, wakeup and callback lifetime; it does not close job-control, callback-provider or independent review gates.

mutation_commit.analysis: OWN-11: The read mask/ppoll protocol commits notification checks safely, but sigs updates and direct handler work are not a transactional main-loop event dispatch.
mutation_commit.invariant: Atomic read wakeup does not make all handler mutations atomic.
limitations: This is source review of current registrations, wakeup and callback lifetime; it does not close job-control, callback-provider or independent review gates.

release_pair.analysis: OWN-11: IoWait and RestoreMask unwind normally; terminate directly calls quit and filter handlers can free memory while an interrupted owner retains aliases.
release_pair.invariant: Handler-triggered release remains an explicit open hazard.
limitations: This is source review of current registrations, wakeup and callback lifetime; it does not close job-control, callback-provider or independent review gates.

error_cleanup.analysis: OWN-11: Failed sigaction and native error sentinels are not represented with a separate error type; asynchronous quit can enter partial cleanup during interrupted work.
error_cleanup.invariant: Error cleanup cannot be assumed reentry-safe.
limitations: This is source review of current registrations, wakeup and callback lifetime; it does not close job-control, callback-provider or independent review gates.

signals_handoff.analysis: OWN-11: psignals performs some deferred resize/job-control work, but SIGINT, SIGUSR1 and termination retain direct mutation; the four M0-SIG findings stay open.
signals_handoff.invariant: This cycle is hazard-recorded, never signal-safe approved.
limitations: This is source review of current registrations, wakeup and callback lifetime; it does not close job-control, callback-provider or independent review gates.
